_comment: Cross-platform recovery-escrow KAT. The SAME fixed (prfSecret, seeds, nonce) → the SAME pinned ciphertext on webapp / iOS / Android. Wrap = base64(nonce(12) ‖ AES-256-GCM(HKDF-SHA256(prf, <salt>, info='', 32), nonce, plaintext) ‖ tag(16)). The wrappedB64 blobs are asserted byte-identical in apps/web/tests/recoveryWrapKat.test.ts and decrypted verbatim by iOS AdminRootTests.swift + Android RecoveryWrapTest.kt. Any drift in HKDF salts, info, nonce framing, or AES-GCM tag handling breaks one platform's assertion. Regenerate via scripts against apps/web/public/recovery/recoveryWrap.js.
